title: System Map Fidelity and Era-Boundary Attribution Study

technologyEras.note: Era boundaries are design context, not automatic balance gates; individual lineages may introduce or mature on different schedules.

symmetryGate.note: Same physical ships under side-swap and mover-swap mirrors must reproduce the same combat, information, EW, power, missile, and damage outcomes.

studyLanes.adjacentPopulation: Exact CP125 adjacent-TL pairing design re-executed on the full System Map; measures total coherent generation advantage and provides direct axial/full-map control comparison.
studyLanes.matchedComposition: Every lower-TL legal composition with an exact higher-TL counterpart; holds build composition fixed to isolate coherent stat/capability progression.
studyLanes.movementHotspots: Exact CP125 same-TL TL2 and TL7 pairing IDs re-executed on the full map to quantify movement-order sensitivity and geometry effects.
studyLanes.swarmerLifecycle: TL7-TL9 matched GP/Swarmer attackers crossed with matched no-PDS/AMM defenders; tests whether mature Swarmer retains an anti-PDS niche without assuming TL8/TL9 upgrades.
studyLanes.energyIsolation: TL7-TL9 matched Energy/Kinetic attackers crossed with matched no-Shield/Shield defenders; separates shield-facing advantage from general late-Energy strength.
studyLanes.lateMissileGeometry: TL8-TL9 exact CP125 same-TL Missile-vs-Missile pairing IDs re-executed on the full map; directly tests whether late unresolved duration survives actual missile pursuit, rerouting, and finite-map geometry.
